goal:
# fix runner auto update system

Runners are currently not automatically updating right if they are on a remote system.they should update to the latest version compatible with their backend (and updates should be manageable by the backend 

currently I dont think releases are releasing right or something and keenly our server2 runner for kainbain regularly says out of date
body:
# fix runner auto update system

Runners are currently not automatically updating right if they are on a remote system.they should update to the latest version compatible with their backend (and updates should be manageable by the backend 

currently I dont think releases are releasing right or something and keenly our server2 runner for kainbain regularly says out of date
